## 待维护者裁决 · ux-conventions.write-feedback acceptance[1] · devx seat 2 · 2026-10-26T13:16Z

**State:** `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`. #26109 已合并(`f0eb9bb8`),本卡 5 条里 4 条已落地，只剩这一条，所以卡保持打开。

**一句话问题:** 保存成功后，用户看到「任务 创建成功」「Settings saved」或「Flow "Reassign Task" completed」,却看不出是*哪一条*记录变了。这类提示应该算「说清了改了什么」还是算不合格?

**背景:** 清单条款 acceptance[1] 原文是 "success feedback names what changed — the record, item or count — rather than a bare 'Success' or a machine name"。QA run #25817(`6679644a`)在三处只看到对象名或页面名，规则没法判，于是请求裁决。

**Governing text:** 维护者 2026-10-07 原话(条目 source[0]):「每个写操作都有反馈」「不对用户显示机器名」。原话没有讲「必须点名到具体记录」。检索 `success toast should name the record` 与 `write feedback toast names what changed`,两条都是 0 hit;ADR 无。

**协议:** 不涉及。这是清单口径加 UI 文案，不改 spec,也不改 `/meta`。

**前提(可复核):** `git grep -n "createSuccess" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 取到 `${label} created successfully`(只插对象标签);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/SettingsPage.tsx:152` 是 `Settings saved`;流程完成的提示由 `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts` 生成，形如 `Flow "…" completed`。

### 选项

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户感受 | 工作量 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A 宽 | 对象名就算点名;只改清单条款措辞 | 提示不变，批量录入时仍分不清刚存的是哪条 | devx · 1 PR · 约 10 行账本(先例 #26109 ux-conventions +14/−8) |
| B 严 | 三处都必须点名具体记录或数量;记 FAIL,给 ui 立 3 张卡 | 所有提示都带记录标题;设置页要硬造一个主语 | devx 账本 1 PR + ui 3 张卡;无先例 |
| C 分(推荐) | 记录级写入必须点名记录(标题)或数量。单例页(设置)和具名自动化(Flow "X")本身已经是主语，算合格。条款写明这条边界 | 新建或编辑记录时看到「任务「季度复盘」已创建」;设置页不变 | devx 账本 1 PR + ui 1 张卡(`form.createSuccess` 及编辑成功提示带记录标题);无先例 |

**业务含义:** A 好比收银小票只印「商品已售出」;B 要求连「系统设置」也写出改了哪个设置项;C 的做法和 Salesforce 一样，记录写入时写出记录名(`Account "Acme" was created.`),设置页只写「Changes saved」。

### 四轴
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：C 把「主语」定义成一条可判的规则(记录写入要点名记录，单例和具名对象自带主语),没有为每个页面造特例。A 让条款失去判别力，B 会逼出硬造主语的文案特例。
- ② 实际业务拉动：今天受影响的是连续录入或批量编辑记录的用户，看不出刚存的是哪条;设置页没人反映过这个问题。拉动集中在记录写入上。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：C 是闭合的二分(记录级 vs 单例/具名),跑清单的 agent 能稳定判同一行。A 什么都放过，等于静默容忍;B 会让 agent 在设置页上判出假 FAIL。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：C 只多一个 i18n 插值参数(记录标题),不新增声明键;B 要给三处都加文案契约。
Prior rulings read: "success toast should name the record" / "write feedback toast names what changed" → 0 hits; ADR none; thread: none

**推荐 C.** 只看 ① 就选 C:两年后平台的样子应当和主流 CRM 一致，记录写入写出记录名，设置页用通用确认。②③④ 是否翻转：否。置信缺口：`form.createSuccess` 拿记录标题要看各对象 `titleField` 是否齐全，这一点我没有实测;缺标题时退回对象名，这个降级是 ui 卡的事。

**不取 A:** 条款会失去判别力，连续录入时分不清记录的问题会一直留着。**不取 B:** 设置页和具名流程本来就有主语，硬造只会增加文案负担。

**裁后执行:** 选 C:本席派一张 devx 账本 PR,把 acceptance[1] 写成「记录级写入点名记录或数量;单例页与具名自动化以其名称为主语」,bump revision,history 引本卡;并给 ui 车道立 1 张卡(`form.createSuccess` 与编辑成功提示插记录标题)。选 A:只派账本 PR。选 B:账本 PR 加 3 张 ui 卡。三种都由本席落地后关卡。

**相关:** #25807(18.2.0 波次锚)· PR #26109(本卡其余 4 条，已合并)· QA run #25817。

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #399 as its one item: the fork devx seat 2 raised in 6416962662 (acceptance[1] of `ux-conventions.write-feedback`), the other four lines of this card having landed in PR #26109. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `cdd4eea9`; the seat's analysis is not restated):
- Premises hold: `form.createSuccess` is `'{{object}} created successfully'` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:325`) and both call sites pass only `{ object: label }` (`AppContent.tsx:817`, `:843`); `SettingsPage.tsx:152` toasts a fixed "Settings saved"; the flow toast is built in `flowResponse.ts` from the run's status. The clause under test is `ux-conventions.json:63` ("success feedback names what changed — the record, item or count — rather than a bare 'Success' or a machine name"); the maintainer's 2026-10-07 words it cites say every write has feedback and no machine names — nothing about naming the record.
- `git grep -iE 'names what changed|success feedback'` on AGENTS.md + docs/adr → 0 rulings (the clause itself is the only hit); ADR none. ADR-0079 (record display name, canonical `nameField`) is the platform mechanism C would use for the title in the create toast — the create response carries the record, so the title is available at the toast site; the fallback to the object label when an object declares no title is the ui card's one edge.
- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **C** (record-level writes name the record title or the count; singleton pages and named automations are their own subject; the clause says so). Workload (card column): devx ledger · 1 PR (~10 lines, precedent #26109 +14/−8) + ui · 1 card (`form.createSuccess` and the edit-success toast carry the record title). Not A (the clause loses its test) and not B (a forced subject on the settings page).
Prior rulings read: `success feedback` · `names what changed` · `createSuccess` → the clause and the two call sites only; ADR-0079 as mechanism; thread: 6416962662.

Ruling: batch #399 item 1 · letter C · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T14:04Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, brief 6417619020) on the fork devx seat 2 raised in 6416962662. Letter **C**: acceptance[1] of `ux-conventions.write-feedback` reads — a record-level write names the record (its title) or the count; a singleton page (settings) and a named automation (`Flow "X" completed`) are their own subject and pass as they are; the clause states that boundary. The 2026-10-07 words it cites (every write has feedback; no machine names) are unchanged in meaning; this ruling sharpens the test the clause performs. Not A (the clause loses its test) and not B (a forced subject on the settings page, three ui cards).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): devx ledger · 1 PR (~10 lines, precedent #26109 +14/−8: acceptance[1] reworded, `revision` bumped, `history` cites this card and run #25817) + ui · 1 card (`form.createSuccess` — `'{{object}} created successfully'`, `en.ts:325`, call sites `AppContent.tsx:817`/`:843` — and the edit-success toast carry the record title via ADR-0079's display name, falling back to the object label when an object declares no title).

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:dispatched` in this act (devx seat 2 holds the card, claim 6415957906; the assignee stays). The holding seat dispatches the ledger PR and files the ui card with `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment, then closes this card once the ledger PR lands (the ui card tracks its own landing). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
